no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for TAVALISSE (fostamatinib, NDA209299). The Multidiscipline Review's Section 8 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants, so the AdComm had no influence on the approval.
